# Third-party code: hermes-gateway-bench (slot 128)

No new external crates and no copied code. `hermes-gateway` gains an optional path dependency
`hermes-bench` (feature `bench`) plus dev-dependencies `hermes-bench` and `bench-banking`. All of
these are workspace crates, MIT, Copyright (c) 3000 Galion / galion-studio. Cargo.lock changes only
in the `hermes-gateway` dependency list (`bench-banking`, `hermes-bench`). Nothing was added to the
registry package set.
